findings.title: DatePicker integration tests do not exercise the UTC+ display regression
findings.why_it_matters: The change fixes how an initial UTC date is converted for Pikaday in the browser's local timezone, but the browser timezone is not set to UTC+ and neither test asserts how the initial September 20 value is displayed or selected when the picker opens. The JS test immediately selects day 16 and checks only that newly selected value, while the server test checks the round trip for a newly selected day. Those checks can pass with the old _unlocal_date implementation, especially on a UTC browser, so they give no regression signal for the reported previous-day display.
findings.suggested_fix: Run the browser under an explicit UTC+ timezone and assert that opening the picker for the initial 2019-09-20 value shows/selects September 20 (including the input's displayed value) before changing it. Keep the existing selection round-trip checks for the selected date.

testing_gaps: Selenium/browser execution is unavailable in this run, so test behavior could not be observed directly.
